_about: Contract between the platform verb get_report_pack and this skill. Version 1. The pack is computed by the server; the skill never calculates a figure. The copy is written by Claude and sent to render_report; the server merges the two into the template and prints the PDF. The copy's exact shape is copy.schema.json, generated from the schema render_report checks.
_rules: Every number shown on a page comes from pack.figures[key].display (or a *Display field on a list row). Nothing is formatted or calculated in the skill.

A figure is {value, display, mom, prev, source}. value is the raw number. display is the string to print. mom is null or {display, direction} with direction 'up' | 'down' | 'flat', always against the previous month. prev is null or {display}. source is 'screenshot' | 'windsor' | 'metricool' | 'ghl' | 'lookup'.
pack.pages is the ordered list of pages this client has data for this month. A page key missing from pack.pages is not rendered. pack.page[<key>] holds that page's lists and the figure keys it shows.

Placeholders in copy.json text: {ig.views} prints display, {ig.views.mom} prints mom.display, {ig.views.change} prints mom.display without its sign (for copy after 'rose' or 'fell'), {ig.views.prev} prints prev.display. Only keys present in pack.figures are legal.
A takeaway in the copy must not contain a digit outside a placeholder. render_report refuses it and names the page.

Every post, video and ad carries a short ref: ig1, ig2, fb1, tt1, li1, ad1, numbered per prefix in the order the pack lists them. The same post keeps the same ref on every page. The copy names posts by ref (postNames keys, what-worked posts, omitPosts), never by id. An unknown ref is refused by name.
Image URLs are presigned and last 7 days. render_report downloads them when it prints; an image that does not load shows a neutral block and is named in the result's warnings.

Key dates come from pack.page['looking-ahead'].keyDates: every planner date for the month after the report month, the account manager's and the planner agent's, up to 8, in date order. When it is empty, copy.pages['looking-ahead'].keyDates is used (written from the account manager's notes), else pack.notes.keyDates. Every block in copy.pages['looking-ahead'].blocks is rendered.
A competitor row with rounded true holds a count the profile showed only rounded: followersDisplay prints it with a tilde ('~38K') and changeDisplay is null, so 'vs last month' shows a dash.
Post stat lines ('1 share', '2 shares') are built by the template from the *Display values, so the pack sends counts, not sentences.
pack.missing lists inputs still needed before the report is complete; each has a key and a plain message for the account manager.
